questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution abolishes 'Untouchability'?

options.explanation: Incorrect. Article 15 prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
Incorrect. Article 16 guarantees equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.
Correct! Article 17 abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form.
Incorrect. Article 18 deals with the abolition of titles except military and academic distinctions.

questions.question: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?

options.explanation: Incorrect. He was the President of the Constituent Assembly.
Correct! Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was appointed Chairman of the Drafting Committee on August 29, 1947.
Incorrect. He was the Chairman of the Union Constitution Committee.
Incorrect. He served as the Constitutional Advisor to the Constituent Assembly.
